# ViperMesh for Blender

> ViperMesh for Blender is an open-source local Blender addon and persistent
> Model Context Protocol server for AI agents. It exposes deterministic 3D
> scene operations, structured inspection, bounded batching, local task
> guidance, and an explicit custom Python fallback.

Canonical repository: https://github.com/Ker102/vipermesh-blender
License: MIT
Runtime: Node.js 20+ and Blender
Transport: MCP over stdio, then a loopback TCP bridge to Blender

## Primary documentation

- README: https://github.com/Ker102/vipermesh-blender#readme
- Connector manual: https://github.com/Ker102/vipermesh-blender/blob/main/docs/portable-blender-mcp.md
- Security boundary: https://github.com/Ker102/vipermesh-blender/blob/main/SECURITY.md
- Releases: https://github.com/Ker102/vipermesh-blender/releases

## Key facts

- One MCP process should remain alive for the complete agent session.
- The process retains one lazy, serialized Blender connection.
- Agents should call bootstrap_vipermesh_session first.
- Deterministic tools are preferred when they cover the task.
- execute_code remains available for genuinely custom Blender work.
- The public connector does not include ViperMesh authentication, billing,
  private prompts, private RAG data, cloud model routing, or asset catalogs.
